conclusion: Current 4P/4C bounded cold trace did not reproduce a Hyle slower result in four AB/BA processes. This is not a stable overall queue ranking, equivalence conclusion, or warm-operation result. No queue implementation change.

method.trace: 200000 distinct uint64 ids 1..200000; 4 producers x50000, 4 consumers; usable capacity1024 on each side. Producer full retries and consumer pre-done empty retries yield. After acquire all-done each consumer retries pop before accepting empty. Per-consumer local count/sum/xor aggregated after join; mismatch aborts. No shared per-item checksum counter.
method.interval: Each iteration includes construction/allocation, sequential creation of 8 std::threads, all transfers, join, conservation check, thread vector destruction and queue destruction. One transfer is reported per batch item; original console unit label op means an item passed through push+pop, not an individual try call.
method.schedule: One process per AB or BA: AB, BA, AB, BA. Each arm has one untimed warmup cold episode followed by 11 epochs x2 complete cold episodes. Raw JSON elapsed is seconds per episode; actual epoch window = elapsed * iterations. No sample trimming, no old launcher, no background monitor during formal.
method.fairness: Both default fixed-ring libraries and their default allocation/slot-layout/destruction costs are included. Hyle uses SystemAllocator; rigtorp uses its default aligned allocator and allocates capacity+1 slots while usable remains1024. This does not isolate queue CAS costs. No producer tokens, queue growth, sharded capacity, or moodycamel rows enter this comparison.

same_path_AA.limitation: Only one same-path process, no CI. The second peer-named label calls BoundedQueue too. Do not subtract this drift from AB results or assign its cause. First AA arm was flagged unstable by nanobench and retained.

clock.limitation: Hardware QPC tick and empirical nanobench clock resolution are separate from epoch/process variation. Millisecond epoch windows do not make the observed variation a hardware timer-resolution result.

resources.configured: 8 queue workers plus caller. Actual process mask0x5555 selects one logical processor on each of8 distinct physical cores, actual Windows EfficiencyClass1; no worker singleton pin. ABOVE_NORMAL process priority, verified child mask/priority for every formal process. All32 OS logical processors remain available to unrelated processes.
resources.actual_diagnostic: resource-live-handles-ab is a separate monitored, non-ranking process. 128 live-handle snapshots over about0.254s; each affinity was read with its thread handle open. They are not accumulated exited TIDs and are not formal-process snapshots.
resources.additional_threads: Peak12 exceeds the9 explicitly requested by benchmark code. Three additional observed threads were not attributed to a runtime component; no claim that only9 OS threads existed.
resources.limits: Live snapshot cap covers the early part of the separate process, not a continuous per-arm thread census. Formal thread resources are established by identical source construction and verified inherited process mask; diagnostic is supplementary and cannot retroactively prove formal worker snapshots.

One BoundedQueue A/A process has73.29 versus64.49ns/item; its first arm has12.2% within-process MAPE.
